task.question: What breakthrough did physicists at Northwestern University demonstrate on October 21?
task.evidence: 21 October – Physicists at Northwestern University demonstrate the first one-positron quantum cyclotron, trapping a single positron (the antimatter counterpart of the electron) for months and controlling its quantum states. The breakthrough could enable unprecedented measurements of the particle's magnetic moment, providing more stringent tests of CPT symmetry.
